auth: active STREAMER or ADMIN; existing manager_user dependency

request_body.article_text: string; non-whitespace; maximum 20000 Unicode code points
request_body.source_url: string; maximum 2048 characters; HTTP(S) absolute URL; no credentials

response_shape.source_url: validated input URL; source label only, never fetched

mentions.mention: string; literal mention appearing in article_text
mentions.evidence: string; literal non-empty substring of article_text
mentions.reason: string; Korean explanation of validation or hold
mentions.entity: null when held; otherwise {id: DB internal integer ID, name: Korean name or original fallback, detail_path: existing /teams/{slug} or /players/{slug}}

response_shape.relevance_evidence: short literal excerpt of article_text; missing/unverifiable evidence downgrades to uncertain

scenario_behavior.complete: 200 mentions with validated links and/or held mentions
scenario_behavior.empty: 200 {source_url, relevance, relevance_evidence, mentions: []}; distinguish football with no validated links, not_football, uncertain
scenario_behavior.limited: 429 with safe user-facing detail and Retry-After
scenario_behavior.unavailable: 503 model unavailable or invalid structured output
scenario_behavior.timeout: 504 bounded model request exceeded time limit

notes_for_be: Frontend mock first; backend starts after operator contract review.
Use separate Vertex news adapter and dedicated config, default gemini-3.5-flash/global. No API-Football calls.
Treat article instructions as data. Never fetch URL or run HTML. Do not log article text or model payload.
LLM cannot supply trusted IDs or URLs. Server validates literal evidence and unambiguous actual DB names/translations before forming detail_path.
No short surname-only match; ambiguous and missing candidates remain held with entity null.
Limit extracted mentions, candidate count, generation tokens, concurrent model calls and per-user calls. Provider timeout 60 seconds; bounded total analysis time.
No writes, publishing or analysis history. Existing public news remains unchanged.
UI aborts on input changes and ignores stale responses; server must still limit calls.
Frontend JS length limit is currently UTF-16 units (conservatively stricter for astral characters); backend code point limit is authoritative.
v2: One model call jointly classifies football relevance and extracts mentions. Only football may contain linked entities. Domain alone or instructions alone cannot establish football relevance.

v2: Client computes UTF-16 spans in original JS snapshot within validated evidence only. First supported occurrence per mention; longest overlapping name wins. Original whitespace/newlines/HTML remain text nodes.
v2: Deterministic first token of DB firstname plus complete lastname is unioned with existing exact candidates; only one union candidate links.
v2: Hover/focus/tap uses existing generalApi.team/player GET only, no model/provider calls and no polling. Detail GET results are cached by entity type+DB id during current analysis.

detail_get_reuse.player: GET /api/v1/players/{slug}: player/profile.nationality/current_team/season_stats (latest identified season; per league+team row, no sum, NULL means missing)
